scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [ProcessHandoffFriction] 60-90 minutes of unpaid admin work every day after physical work hours (intensity 9/10, stage: Quote Request Received) ← flagged as binding
2. [DataSignalFriction] Under-quoting due to lack of market data, leaving thousands of dollars on the table annually (intensity 8/10, stage: Quote Drafted) ← flagged as binding
3. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Delayed invoicing and inconsistent payment follow-up causing cash flow stress (intensity 9/10, stage: Payment Monitored) ← flagged as binding
4. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] Existing tools require manual data entry and don't learn from tradie behavior (intensity 7/10, stage: Data Synchronized)
5. [DataSignalFriction] BAS obligations arrive as quarterly shocks rather than planned obligations (intensity 6/10, stage: Intelligence Generated)

cc_customer.description: A business entity that engages with the organization for services and maintains an ongoing relationship

senses.description: Potential customer who has submitted a quote request but not yet engaged services
Customer with approved quotes and scheduled or completed jobs
Customer receiving regular intelligence briefs and analysis services

cc_customer.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query CRM system for customer records, service management system for active engagements, and intelligence platform for subscribers

cc_quote.description: A formal pricing proposal for services provided to customers

senses.description: Initial pricing analysis and proposal under development
Finalized quote approved by business owner and ready for customer acceptance

cc_quote.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query pricing system for quote calculations and quote management system for approval status

cc_quote_request.description: An inquiry from a customer seeking pricing for specific services

senses.description: Initial customer inquiry received through various channels

cc_quote_request.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query communication system for incoming requests and CRM for customer context

cc_job.description: A scheduled service engagement with a customer based on an approved quote

senses.description: Service engagement planned and resourced but not yet executed
Service engagement that has been delivered and quality assured

cc_job.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query resource planning system for job schedules and service delivery system for completion status

cc_intelligence_brief.description: A compiled analysis document containing prioritized intelligence insights for customers

senses.description: Regular automated intelligence summary delivered to subscribers
Tailored intelligence report based on specific customer profile analysis

cc_intelligence_brief.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query intelligence platform for brief generation and analysis system for custom reports

cc_data_profile.description: Integrated customer data synchronized from multiple sources for analysis

senses.description: Newly synchronized customer data requiring processing and analysis
Processed customer data with patterns identified and intelligence extracted

cc_data_profile.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query data integration platform for synchronized profiles and analytics engine for processed insights

cc_invoice.description: A financial document requesting payment for completed services

senses.description: Newly created invoice based on completed job awaiting payment
Invoice that has exceeded payment terms and requires follow-up

cc_invoice.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query financial management system for invoice records and payment monitoring system for status tracking

cc_payment.description: Financial transaction from customer settling invoice obligations

senses.description: Payment anticipated based on invoice terms and monitoring
Actual payment received and processed from customer

cc_payment.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query financial management system for payment records and monitoring system for payment tracking

pc_quote_approval_authority.name: Quote Approval Authority
pc_quote_approval_authority.description: All quotes must be approved by business owner before customer delivery

outcomes.description: Business owner must review and approve all quotes before customer delivery
Quote analysts cannot deliver quotes directly to customers without approval

pc_data_access_control.name: Data Access Control
pc_data_access_control.description: Customer data access must be properly authenticated and authorized before synchronization

outcomes.description: Must verify customer authentication before granting data access
Must implement proper security controls during data synchronization

pc_payment_follow_up.name: Payment Follow-up Authorization
pc_payment_follow_up.description: Overdue payment follow-up actions require business owner or client manager approval

outcomes.description: Must obtain approval from business owner or client manager before initiating payment follow-up
Approved follow-up actions may include direct customer communication

pc_intelligence_quality.name: Intelligence Quality Assurance
pc_intelligence_quality.description: Intelligence briefs must meet quality standards and incorporate customer feedback

outcomes.description: Must prioritize content based on customer relevance and importance
Must capture and incorporate customer feedback for continuous improvement

pc_job_completion_verification.name: Job Completion Verification
pc_job_completion_verification.description: All jobs must undergo quality assurance before being marked complete

conditions.expression: cc_job:Scheduled Job is ready for completion

outcomes.description: Must perform quality assurance checks before marking job as complete
Must document job completion and deliverables
